blocks.text: This tab preserves the prose stories written in the shared Cyberpath conversation. Later rewritten prose is presented as the primary version. Earlier prose drafts are retained in the Archived / Superseded Story Drafts section rather than silently deleted.
Story plans, option tables, and unwritten seeds are not presented as completed fiction. The Corrected Child is explicitly marked unfinished because only Part One was written.

Document capacity note: the linked archive contains every primary story and every superseded prose draft. This tab preserves the in-document index and the portion that fit without deleting existing CyberPetProject material.
